summary: Stonepeak-Plus Infrastructure Fund LP filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units to third-party investors for aggregate consideration of approximately $17.85 million, finalized July 27, 2026, at transactional NAV per unit as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine continuous private offering under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, not a special situation. No board action, transaction structure, or strategic event is involved. The filing also discloses the fund's transactional NAV per class. This is an ordinary capital-raising report, not a restructuring, tender, or other listed category.
